categories.name: Historical payment behaviour: the company as payer
Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")

datapoints.name: OP financing rejections
datapoints.definition: OP financing leads (fact_lead_financing) and loan applications (fact_loan_application) with status REJECTED, all history. NULL without any lead or application. Thin: 124 rejected leads and 13 rejected applications on 2026-10-02.

datapoints.name: OP credit line in use
datapoints.definition: In-use amount over the approved platform limit on ACTIVE OP financing contracts (fact_lead_financing). NULL without an active contract. Thin: 13 active contracts on 2026-10-02.

datapoints.name: DJP says annual returns are filed
datapoints.definition: TRUE when the newest DJP check says the annual returns are filed (status valid), FALSE when it says not valid. NULL without a check. Read from npwp_validation_access_log_enriched.latest_tax_return_status (D4); most checks date from 2024.

datapoints.name: On-time tax payment rate
datapoints.definition: Share of monthly tax obligations (KAP and tax period) paid through OP on or before the statutory deadline. 24 tax periods ending at the payment watermark (the DAI-559 rule over companies' last paid period). KJS 100, 104, 420 on PPN, PPh 21, 22, 23, 25, 26 and 4(2) or final UMKM. NULL under 6 OP-paid obligations.

datapoints.name: Value-weighted days late
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted days paid after the deadline (0 when on time), over the same OP-paid obligations as the on-time ratio. Amounts above 10 trillion IDR are treated as corrupt and left out. NULL under 6 obligations.

datapoints.name: Late payment level
datapoints.definition: RP-002 on a three-step scale: ON_TIME (0 days late), LATE (above 0 to 30 days), VERY_LATE (above 30 days). NULL when RP-002 is NULL (under 6 OP-paid obligations). There is no not-paid step: a payment made outside OP looks the same as an unpaid one.

datapoints.name: Industry average value added
datapoints.definition: Leave-one-out mean of the value-added ratio (RP-039) across the company's KBLI 2025 peer group, each value floored at -1. NULL without a peer group or under 30 peers with a value.

datapoints.name: Value added vs peers
datapoints.definition: Leave-one-out percentile of the value-added ratio (RP-039) within the company's KBLI 2025 peer group: the share of peers with a lower value. NULL under 30 peers with a value.

datapoints.name: Purchase-to-sale lag
datapoints.definition: Median, across CAP-D categories both bought and sold, of the value-weighted mean sale date minus the value-weighted mean purchase date (12-month windows). 0 when the company sells a category before it buys it.

datapoints.name: Capex share of purchases
datapoints.definition: Capital-goods share of purchases, 12 months to the purchase watermark: value in UNSPSC segments for machinery, vehicles, land and buildings, tools, laboratory, IT and telecom equipment and furniture, over value that carries a UNSPSC segment. Purchases before 2025 carry almost no item detail.
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Pricing power
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted price trend of items priced in both halves of the 12-month window (last 6 months against the 6 before, each item capped at -100% and +100%), sale side minus purchase side. From -2 to 2. NULL under 3 such items per side. Thin.

datapoints.name: Payroll intensity
datapoints.definition: Gross payroll (fact_monthly_employee_tax) over observed sales in the company's last 12 payroll months. Payroll data ends in 2023. NULL without sales in those months. Can exceed 1.
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Categories bought
datapoints.definition: CAP-D categories with purchase value, 12 months to the purchase watermark. Revenue purchases only (DAI-650): a line whose UNSPSC segment is a capital good or an operational need (risk_pulse_non_revenue_segments_sql) is left out unless the company also sells in that segment; lines without a segment stay in. 0 when every purchase is left out.

datapoints.name: Items bought
datapoints.definition: Distinct items with purchase value, 12 months to the purchase watermark.
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Top category share of purchases
datapoints.definition: Largest CAP-D category's share of categorised purchase value, 12 months to the purchase watermark. Uncategorised value is left out of the denominator. Revenue purchases only (DAI-650): a line whose UNSPSC segment is a capital good or an operational need (risk_pulse_non_revenue_segments_sql) is left out unless the company also sells in that segment; lines without a segment stay in.

datapoints.name: Export share of sales
datapoints.definition: Share of own sales value on export invoices (invoice_type SALE_EXPORT), 12 months to the own-sale watermark (OP-issued sales only).
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Trade role
datapoints.definition: Most common monthly trade role in mart_summary_trade_labels_monthly (the month's highest-scoring label) over the 12 months to the latest labelled month, for example Originator/Producer or Large Distributor/Wholesaler. Joined on the 15-digit NPWP.

datapoints.name: Role stability
datapoints.definition: Share of the labelled months (same 12 months) in value_chain_trade_role_name.

datapoints.name: Service share of sales
datapoints.definition: Service share of observed sales value, 12 months to the sale watermark: value on service lines over value on goods, service and other lines (dim_item_product_service.line_type), the same denominator as value_chain_sale_goods_value_ratio. Gives a service company a measure of its own (DAI-650).
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Resale signature
datapoints.definition: Share of categorised observed sales (12 months to the sale watermark) in CAP-D categories the company also buys (12 months to the purchase watermark).
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Anonymous-buyer share
datapoints.definition: Share of own sales value to invoices without a buyer entity, exports left out, 12 months to the own-sale watermark (OP-issued sales only).

datapoints.name: Seasonality vs peers
datapoints.definition: Leave-one-out percentile of the seasonality ratio within the peer group. NULL under 30 peers with a value.

datapoints.name: Seasonal alignment with industry
datapoints.definition: Correlation, over the 12 calendar months, between the company's sales profile (calendar-month mean over its average) and the leave-one-out average profile of its peer group. From -1 to 1. NULL without a seasonality ratio, all 12 months, or 30 peers with a profile.

datapoints.name: Lebaran dependency
datapoints.definition: Share of observed sales in the 12 months to the sale watermark dated in the Lebaran window (30 days before to 7 days after Idul Fitri). About 0.10 for an even year. NULL under 12 months of span.

datapoints.name: Year-end share vs peers
datapoints.definition: Leave-one-out percentile of the year-end ratio (RP-057) within the peer group, so a Q4-heavy company reads against its industry (DAI-650). NULL under 30 peers with a value.
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Customers with their own record
datapoints.definition: Customers seen through their own purchase records (mirrored channel), 12 months to the sale watermark. Read beside every customer column: few buyers means a thin view, not few customers.
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Largest customer's share
datapoints.definition: Largest resolved customer's share of resolved observed sales, 12 months to the sale watermark. NULL under 3 customers.

datapoints.name: Customer concentration (HHI)
datapoints.definition: Customer concentration: sum of squared customer shares of resolved observed sales (0 to 1; 1 = one customer), 12 months to the sale watermark.

datapoints.name: Customer industry spread
datapoints.definition: 1 minus the HHI of resolved customer value across customer industry divisions (KLU, else KBLI 2025). 0 = one industry. NULL under 3 customers with a known division.

datapoints.name: Customer province spread
datapoints.definition: 1 minus the HHI of resolved customer value across customer provinces (dim_address). NULL under 3 customers with a known province.

datapoints.name: Purchases from bad-status suppliers
datapoints.definition: Share of resolved purchase value from suppliers whose newest DJP check reads taxpayer NE, DE or not valid, Coretax non efektif, or annual return not valid (D4). 12 months to the purchase watermark. Internal only (D3).

datapoints.name: Sales to bad-status buyers
datapoints.definition: Share of resolved observed sales to buyers that are non-effective, deregistered, not valid or not filing on the newest DJP check (D4).

datapoints.name: Trade with partners that went quiet
datapoints.definition: TRUE when a resolved partner holding at least 10% of the company's resolved value (both sides, 12 months) has its own last approved invoice, in any role, more than 6 months before the side watermark. NULL without resolved value. A partner gone quiet, not evidence of a shell company. Internal only (D3) (DAI-688).

datapoints.name: Sales to large or listed customers
datapoints.definition: Share of resolved observed sales to customers graded large, publicly listed or state-owned (mart_details_entity). Internal only (D3).

datapoints.name: Sales to government and VAT collectors
datapoints.definition: Share of own sales value with e-Faktur transaction code 02 (to a government treasurer) or 03 (to another appointed VAT collector, state-owned companies among them), 12 months to the own-sale watermark (OP-issued sales only).
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Risk two steps away
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted mean, over the company's corporate trading partners (12 months to the purchase watermark), of each partner's share of corporate trade with non-effective, deregistered, not-valid or not-filing taxpayers. Thin.

datapoints.name: Circular trade flag
datapoints.definition: TRUE when the company sits in 3 or more qualifying loops. NULL without both incoming and outgoing corporate trade in the window. Threshold to be set by the distribution study.

datapoints.name: Trade with partners on both sides
datapoints.definition: Share of resolved value (both sides, 12 months) with counterparties that both buy from and sell to the company.

datapoints.name: Same-category trade both ways
datapoints.definition: TRUE when the company sells and buys the same CAP-D category with the same partner in the 12-month windows. NULL without categorised trade on both sides.

datapoints.name: Typical customer relationship length
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted median customer relationship length: days from the first trade ever (data floor 2014-07) to the last trade in the 12-month window, weighted by window value. Exact.

datapoints.name: Typical supplier relationship length
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted median supplier relationship length, same rule as the customer side.

datapoints.name: Largest customer's relationship length
datapoints.definition: Days from the first trade ever to the last trade in the window with the largest customer.

datapoints.name: Largest supplier's relationship length
datapoints.definition: Days from the first trade ever to the last trade in the window with the largest supplier.

datapoints.name: Sales from customers older than 2 years
datapoints.definition: Share of resolved observed sales from customers first traded more than 24 months before the sale watermark.

datapoints.name: Repeat-customer share
datapoints.definition: Share of resolved observed sales from customers active in 2 or more months of the 12-month window.

datapoints.name: Repeat-supplier share
datapoints.definition: Share of resolved purchase value from suppliers traded in more than one month of the 12-month window.

datapoints.name: Supplier trading regularity
datapoints.definition: Value-weighted active months over the months from first to last trade in the window, suppliers with a span of at least 3 months.

datapoints.name: Invoices per supplier (median)
datapoints.definition: Median distinct invoices per resolved supplier in the window.

datapoints.name: Partner shares a contact
datapoints.definition: TRUE when a resolved trading partner in the window shares a contact (fact_contact_entity) with the company. Contacts linked to more than 5 entities (accountants, consultants) are left out.

datapoints.name: Recurring service fee
datapoints.definition: TRUE when service purchases from one supplier fall in at least 6 of the 12 months and make at least 10% of purchase value. NULL without purchases.

datapoints.name: Suppliers
datapoints.definition: Distinct resolved suppliers on approved purchases, 12 months to the purchase watermark.
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Largest supplier's share
datapoints.definition: Largest resolved supplier's share of resolved purchase value, 12 months to the purchase watermark.

datapoints.name: Supplier concentration (HHI)
datapoints.definition: Supplier concentration: sum of squared supplier shares of resolved purchase value (0 to 1), 12 months to the purchase watermark.

datapoints.name: Single-source purchases
datapoints.definition: Share of categorised purchase value (resolved suppliers) in CAP-D categories bought from a single supplier.

datapoints.name: Supplier industry spread
datapoints.definition: 1 minus the HHI of resolved supplier value across supplier industry divisions. NULL under 3 suppliers with a known division.

datapoints.name: Observed trading age
datapoints.definition: Months from the first approved invoice on either side (own sales, mirrored sales, purchases) to the later side watermark.

datapoints.name: DJP taxpayer status
datapoints.definition: Newest DJP taxpayer status: ACTIVE (aktif or valid), NE (non-effective), DE (deregistered), NOT_VALID. From npwp_validation_access_log_enriched.latest_tax_payer_status (D4). Most checks date from 2024.

datapoints.name: Active in Coretax
datapoints.definition: TRUE when the newest Coretax status check reads aktif, FALSE for non efektif. NULL without a check.

datapoints.name: VAT status
datapoints.definition: VAT registration status from behaviour: pkp, non-pkp or vat collector (mart_details_entity.vat_status_type).

datapoints.name: Observed sales, 12 months
datapoints.definition: Observed sales (own plus mirrored, once per faktur number), sum of tax_base_amount, 12 months to the sale watermark. A lower bound on revenue.

datapoints.name: Purchases, 12 months
datapoints.definition: Approved purchases, sum of tax_base_amount, 12 months to the purchase watermark.

datapoints.name: Business size class (PP 7/2021)
datapoints.definition: Business class under PP 7/2021: large above Rp 50 B, medium above Rp 15 B, small above Rp 2 B, micro above 0 (mart_details_entity.entity_regulatory_size_code, over the same input as entity_size). Replaced the OP revenue bands in DAI-672.

datapoints.name: Pays small-business final tax
datapoints.definition: TRUE when the company paid the small-business final tax (KAP 411128, KJS 420) in the 24 tax periods ending at the payment watermark; FALSE when it paid other taxes only. NULL without a paid tax row.

datapoints.name: Recent purchases of known items
datapoints.definition: Same rule on purchases.

datapoints.name: Purchase price swing per item
datapoints.definition: Same rule on purchases.

datapoints.name: Off-price purchase lines
datapoints.definition: Same as the sale measure, purchase lines.

datapoints.name: Purchase quantity swing per item
datapoints.definition: Same as the sale measure, purchase side.

datapoints.name: Sales volatility
datapoints.definition: Coefficient of variation of monthly observed sales, 24 months to the sale watermark, no zero months after it. NULL under 6 active months.

datapoints.name: Purchase volatility
datapoints.definition: Coefficient of variation of monthly purchase value, from the first active month (at most 24 back) to the purchase watermark month. Zero months inside the span count; no month after the watermark. NULL under 6 active months.

datapoints.name: Months with purchases
datapoints.definition: Months with a purchase over months in the span, same rule on the purchase side.

datapoints.name: Purchase invoicing rhythm
datapoints.definition: Same as the sale measure, purchase invoices, 12 months to the purchase watermark.

datapoints.name: Purchase invoice size vs peers
datapoints.definition: Leave-one-out percentile of the median purchase invoice within the peer group. NULL under 30 peers with a value.
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.name: Spread of purchase invoice sizes
datapoints.definition: Interquartile range over median of purchase invoice amounts. NULL under 10 invoices.

datapoints.name: Cancellations vs peers
datapoints.definition: Leave-one-out percentile of the cancellation ratio within the peer group. NULL under 30 peers with a value. Internal only (D3).

datapoints.name: Replaced share of invoices
datapoints.definition: Replaced or amended value (REPLACED, AMENDED, WAITING_FOR_AMENDMENT) over issued value, same invoices and window as the cancellation ratio.

datapoints.name: Month-to-month dilution swing
datapoints.definition: Standard deviation of the monthly sale dilution rate (cancelled, replaced and amended value over issued value), 12 months to the own-sale watermark (OP-issued sales only). NULL under 6 months with issued value.

datapoints.name: Cancelled after the period closed
datapoints.definition: Share of own cancelled sale invoices with a cancel time (transaction_invoice_sale_enriched.cancelled_timestamp) cancelled after the tax period closed (end of the month after the tax period). NULL under 3 such cancellations.

datapoints.name: Dilution on the top 3 buyers
datapoints.definition: Share of sale dilution value from the 3 buyers with the most dilution. NULL without dilution.

datapoints.name: Stuck draft invoices
datapoints.definition: Share of own sale invoices still DRAFT or REQUIRE_ACTION 30 days or more before the own-sale watermark, 12 months to the own-sale watermark (OP-issued sales only). NULL under 5 invoices.

datapoints.name: Late e-Faktur
datapoints.definition: Share of approved own sale invoices whose e-Faktur record was created after the 15th of the month after the invoice month, 12 months to the own-sale watermark. NULL under 10 invoices.

datapoints.categoryName: Historical payment behaviour: the company as payer
datapoints.name: Days to withhold on suppliers
datapoints.definition: As withholding agent: median days from the referenced supplier invoice (e-Bupot type 02 or COMMERCIALINVOICE) to the slip date, 12 months to the slip watermark. NULL under 5 slips. Month-end batching biases it upward.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Sales in categories rare for the industry
datapoints.definition: Share of categorised sold value in CAP-D categories that carry under 1% of the seller division's categorised value in the purchase window (same reference as transaction_buyer_seller_item_rare_ratio). NULL when under half the sold value can be checked.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Purchases in categories rare for the industry
datapoints.definition: Share of checkable purchase value in CAP-D categories that carry under 1% of the buyer's KLU division value (reference learned on all corporate purchases in the window), 12 months to the purchase watermark. NULL when under half the purchase value is checkable.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Purchases rare for both sides
datapoints.definition: Share of purchase value in categories rare for both the buyer's and the seller's division, over value where both divisions and the category are known. NULL when under half the purchase value is checkable.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Purchases that fit the business
datapoints.definition: Share of categorised purchase value in categories the company also sells, or that carry at least 1% of its division's purchases.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Trade role does not fit resale
datapoints.definition: TRUE when the trade role is a reseller role (distributor, wholesaler, retail) and under 10% of categorised sales are in categories it also buys, or the role is Originator/Producer and over 90% are. NULL without a role or a resale ratio. Reads mart_risk_pulse_entity_value_chain.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Sells more units than it buys
datapoints.definition: TRUE when a CAP-D category and unit both bought and sold shows units sold above 1.5 times units bought (12-month windows). NULL without such a category.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Buying after the last sale
datapoints.definition: Share of purchase value in resold categories whose item was first bought after the category's last sale in the window.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Sales per employee against peers
datapoints.definition: Leave-one-out percentile, within the peer group, of observed sales (12 months) per employee on the latest payroll period (mart_risk_pulse_entity_borrower). Payroll ends in 2023. NULL under 30 peers. Thin.
datapoints.whatIsGood: Best in the middle (too low or too high is risky)

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Prices far from the market
datapoints.definition: Share of the company's priced line value (as seller or buyer) in mart_item_price_index_marketplace with a robust z above 3 against the comparable-item and month median, 12 months to the purchase watermark. Groups need 5 lines.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Round invoice amounts
datapoints.definition: Share of sale invoices that are an exact multiple of 1,000,000 IDR. NULL under 10 invoices.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: First-digit test (Benford)
datapoints.definition: Mean absolute deviation of the first-digit shares of sale invoice amounts from Benford's law. Around 0.006 or less is close conformity. NULL under 50 invoices.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Repeat invoices within a week
datapoints.definition: Share of approved own invoices (sale and purchase) with the same counterparty and rounded amount as another approved invoice within the previous 7 days, 12 months to each side's watermark. NULL under 10 invoices.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Sales at month end
datapoints.definition: Share of sale value dated in the last 3 days of the month (invoice date). NULL under 10 invoices.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Large invoices to new partners
datapoints.definition: Share of invoices of 100M IDR or more dated within 30 days of the first trade with that counterparty. NULL under 3 such invoices.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: VAT overpaid without capital buying
datapoints.definition: TRUE when reported PPN returns (latest revision) show 3 or more consecutive overpaid (LB) months with capital-goods purchases under 50M IDR over those months, 24 periods to the PPN watermark. Purchases without an item category count as no capex, as in the revived PajakSafe rule. The catalogue's second arm (codes 02/03 to non-collectors) is not built. NULL without reported PPN returns.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Input VAT that should not be credited
datapoints.definition: Share of input VAT on approved purchases from a non-PKP seller, marked uncreditable, or on entertainment, gift or hospitality items, 12 months to the purchase watermark.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Sales the buyer never recorded
datapoints.definition: Share of own approved sale invoices to buyers that record purchases in OP whose faktur number is missing from those buyers' purchases, 12 months to the own-sale watermark (OP-issued sales only). NULL under 5 such invoices. Thin.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Any fictitious-invoice hit
datapoints.definition: TRUE when transaction_fictitious_signal_count is above 0.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Invoices outsized for the industry
datapoints.definition: Share of the company's sale invoices at or above its peer group's 99th-percentile edge, leave-one-out: peers' invoices binned at quarter-decade edges from 10K IDR, the edge being the first with at most 1% of peers' invoices at or above it. NULL under 10 invoices or 30 peers with invoices.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Tax period differs from invoice month
datapoints.definition: Share of approved own invoices (both sides, 12 months) whose tax period month differs from the invoice month. NULL under 10 invoices.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: VAT that fits no rate
datapoints.definition: Share of approved own sale invoices with VAT due (not codes 07 or 08, not exports) whose VAT fits none of base x 10%, 11% or 12%, or other base x 11% or 12%, within 1% or 100 IDR, 12 months to the own-sale watermark (OP-issued sales only). NULL under 10 invoices.

datapoints.categoryName: Transaction plausibility and revived rules ("does this make sense")
datapoints.name: Implausible invoice dates
datapoints.definition: Share of own invoices created in the 12 months to the side watermark whose invoice date is before 2000, more than a year before creation, or more than 31 days after it. NULL under 10 invoices.

datapoints.name: Typical payment term
datapoints.definition: Median days from invoice date to a real due date on approved own sale invoices, 12 months to the own-sale watermark. Placeholder due dates (empty, equal to the invoice date, or the last day of the invoice month) are left out. NULL under 5 real terms; about 100 sellers a year.

datapoints.name: Spread of payment terms
datapoints.definition: Standard deviation of payment terms (due date minus invoice date, placeholders left out), 12 months to the own-sale watermark (OP-issued sales only). NULL under 5 terms. Thin.

datapoints.name: Change in payment terms
datapoints.definition: Median term of the last 6 months minus the median of the 6 before. Can be negative. NULL under 3 terms on either side. Thin.
